grammar.title: 情态动词Can、May
lines: 情态动词表示情绪、态度、可能性，后面跟动词的原形，不能单独使用。 情态动词表推测 § may 和 might 表推测翻译为“可能…”，而must做为推测最高级翻译为“肯定...”。may 可以用 might 代替，语气更委婉，更有礼貌，但时间上没有区别。
can 常用于否定句cannot推测为“不可能”与must相反 Can I use your phone please?(能够) Of course you can/may.(肯定)
Could can的过去式是更委婉的表达方式 Could I use your phone please? (能够)
May 疑问句中“May”只能接主语“I” May I use your phone please?(可以) No, you can’t/ may not.(否定)
Might may的过去式，语气与态度上更真诚(现在时中可用) Might I use your phone please?(可以)
may/might + do 表示对现在或未来事情的推测 He may come tomorrow. He might come tomorrow.
may/might + have + done 表示对过去事情的推测 He may have telephoned last night, but I’m not sure. He might have telephoned last night, but I’m not sure.
may/might as well + do 还是…好(无可奈何)，不妨… Do you think he’ll pass that exam? He’ll never pass. He might as well give up.

sentences.title: 情态动词练习
lines: With the help of the new technology, you can E-mail your friends by mobilephone.（中考真题）
Have you decided which senior high school to choose? Not yet. I may go to Moonlight School.（中考真题)
How's your new babysitter? We couldn't ask for a better one. All our kids love her so much.（高考真题）
This TV program is quite boring. We might listen to the music as well. （不妨听听音乐）（四级翻译真题）
